tasks.description: Implement Memory to Build edge. In build-spec.js: add optional args.memory_ref handling with a cheap read-only agent to extract patterns and canaries from a memory roll; implement selectPatterns and formatPatterns pure functions in a sentinel block; inject formatted patterns into the Decomposer prompt under a prior-observations heading. In build-implement.js: add optional args.memory_ref handling; implement selectCanary function in the fix-loop decisions sentinel block to deterministically pick library canaries matching task owned surfaces using a hash of run_id + ':' + task.id; route selected canaries through the existing canary mutation agent; record canary_source ('library'|'args'|'none') and canary_id in EvidenceBundle; update Test Runner and fix-loop repair agent prompts to specify running from task worktree and never writing to main checkout. Both halves degrade silently when memory_ref is missing, unreadable, or malformed. Update header comments in both files to document memory_ref as optional.
